backend_rule: Provider and language-specific code ends at normalized events; the frontend consumes only this contract.

analytics.description: Windowed activity, participant attribution, and logical timestamp observations.
analytics.label: Observation analytics
analytics.reason: Read-only analytics over retained normalized observations.

attributes.description: Decoded or opaque attribute update observations.
attributes.label: Attribute values

commands.description: Explicitly registered adapter actions and correlated execution history.
commands.label: Session commands
commands.reason: No command dispatcher is configured; this backend is read-only.

declarations.description: Explicit scoped class/attribute declarations, not inferred routing or ownership.
declarations.label: Publication and subscription declarations

event_history.description: Bounded, sequence-numbered event retention and cursor pages.
event_history.label: Event history
event_history.reason: Provided by the provider-neutral observer store.

federates.description: Participant join, update, and resignation observations.
federates.label: Federate roster

fom_inspection.description: Adapter-supplied class, field, datatype and dimension metadata with explicit revision and references.
fom_inspection.label: FOM metadata inspection

http_api.description: HTTP resources for contract, state, metrics, and event pages.
http_api.label: HTTP API

interaction_flow.description: Explicit send/receive transmission pairing, scoped endpoints and observer arrival intervals.
interaction_flow.label: Interaction flow inspection
interaction_flow.reason: Exact send/receive counts; pairing requires explicit transmission and endpoint join identities.

lifecycle.description: Connection, startup, shutdown, and runtime errors.
lifecycle.label: Runtime lifecycle

live_inspectors.description: Derived object, interaction, and federate views.
live_inspectors.label: Live inspectors
live_inspectors.reason: Derived from normalized events without requiring provider APIs.

logical_time.description: Time regulation, constraints, grants, and timestamped delivery.
logical_time.label: Logical time

metrics.description: Event counts, rates, retention, and adapter health metrics.
metrics.label: Observer metrics
metrics.reason: Provided by the provider-neutral observer store.

mom_inspection.description: Typed roster coverage, service invocation/error reports and explicit numeric or opaque counters.
mom_inspection.label: Management report inspection

object_observations.description: Persistent attributed object snapshots and retained attribute comparisons.
object_observations.label: Object perspectives
object_observations.reason: Built from explicit event attribution; no MOM or provider queries required.

objects.description: Object discovery, removal, and attribute updates.
objects.label: Object observations

ownership.description: Ownership acquisition, divestiture, and query observations.
ownership.label: Attribute ownership

ownership_inspection.description: Explicit owner state, acquisition/divestiture reports and scoped request/outcome evidence.
ownership_inspection.label: Attribute ownership inspection

persistence.description: Federation save, restore, and related lifecycle observations.
persistence.label: Save and restore

persistence_inspection.description: Named local/federation save/restore phase snapshots and retained transition reports.
persistence_inspection.label: Save and restore inspection

recording.description: Bounded state/envelope journals and validated portable replay files; never provider command execution.
recording.label: Recording and replay
recording.reason: Recording/import resources are disabled by this backend.

recording_analytics_window.description: Accepts the named retained-window request instead of uploading unrelated recorded inspectors.
recording_analytics_window.label: Lightweight recorded analytics
recording_analytics_window.reason: Named validated retained-window requests; legacy complete-frame requests remain accepted.

recording_compact.description: Explicitly negotiated v2 baseline/edit capture/import/export, bounded reconstruction and unchanged evidence.
recording_compact.label: Compact recording files
recording_compact.reason: Negotiated v2 baseline/edit files with bounded reconstructed state/work; v1 remains supported.

regions.description: Region creation and region-scoped publication or subscription.
regions.label: Regions and DDM

regions_inspection.description: Explicit extents, exact dimension ranges, associations and declared/observed routing evidence.
regions_inspection.label: Region and DDM inspection

relationships.description: Adapter-reported producer/recipient edges with stable scoped join identities, not inferred routing.
relationships.label: Explicit federation relationships
relationships.reason: Synthetic explicit edges; not inferred from declarations or delivery.

sse.description: Live event delivery over an HTTP event stream.
sse.label: Server-sent events

storage_inspection.description: Explicit count/byte budgets, whole-record expiry and unbudgeted collection coverage; not federation lifecycle evidence.
storage_inspection.label: Observation storage coverage
storage_inspection.reason: Count/byte expiry coverage is explicit; remaining row-only collections are listed, never silently covered.

synchronization.description: Explicit labels, registration outcomes, announcements and participant achievement reports.
synchronization.label: Synchronization observations
synchronization.reason: Read-only normalized phase inspection; no register/achieve command is implied.

time_inspection.description: Last reported grants/state and bounded explicitly correlated requests, without MOM.
time_inspection.label: Persistent time inspection
time_inspection.reason: Observer-side snapshots; missing IDs or session scope never imply correlated grants.

websocket.description: Live event delivery over a WebSocket connection.
websocket.label: WebSocket stream

state_meanings.available: The feature is supported and enabled for observation.
state_meanings.disabled: The feature is supported or configured but turned off.
state_meanings.partial: Only some of the feature surface is available.
state_meanings.unknown: The provider or backend did not advertise its support.
state_meanings.unsupported: The connected provider or backend cannot provide it.

event_envelope.extension_rule: Unknown fields are retained and must remain JSON-compatible.
